structured.target: Aslan Renewables damless modular hydro CIIC 2025 founders
structured.school_or_org: Aslan Renewables (Canadian deep-tech company; founded in Prince Edward Island)
structured.program_event: Climate Impact Innovations Challenge (CIIC) 2025 — hosted by East Ventures and Temasek Foundation; Grand Finale 11 October 2025 at Indonesia International Sustainability Forum (ISF), Jakarta
structured.what_it_does: Deploys dam-free modular hydropower that turns existing water infrastructure (irrigation canals, check dams, spillways, dormant small dams) into baseload electricity without large reservoirs, major excavation, or new mega-dams. Units are prefabricated, install in days, claim up to ~86% efficiency, and use an AI remote-monitoring layer for autonomous operation, predictive maintenance, and compliance. Aimed at rural electrification and grid/microgrid baseload with low ecological footprint.
structured.place: Founded Prince Edward Island, Canada; company also associated with Toronto, ON; CIIC win and planned pilot deployment in Indonesia (irrigation/canal sites); finale in Jakarta
structured.outcome_or_award: Winner, Energy Transition track, CIIC 2025; one of three winners sharing a total Rp10 billion (~US$600K+) catalytic grant pool to pilot climate tech in Indonesia; company press describes first place in Energy Transition and funding to launch modular hydro pilots with local partners (planned first Indonesian pilot ~2026)
structured.gap: No public full co-founder list beyond Andrew Murray (Antares shows a founding team photo caption but no other names in text). Exact per-winner share of the Rp10B CIIC prize not stated (pool is collective for three winners). Company founding year differs slightly across sources (Antares: 2019; SustainableBiz interview: Murray started the company in 2020). Not a Philippine or Ateneo-linked team; no PH school/LGU affiliation found.
structured.note: SEA climate-tech (CIIC) case, not Youth CLAP / CCC / PH campus. Canadian modular hydro company expanding into Indonesia via CIIC. Tracks for student teams: Energy Transition + damless/run-of-existing-infrastructure hydro + AI ops layer. Peer 2025 winners: Arukah Capital (Sustainable Agriculture), SXD AI (Circular Economy). Later (Nov 2025) closed CA$1.25M pre-seed led by Antares Ventures with MaRS IAF and UCeed Renewable Fund (University of Calgary) — separate from CIIC grant.
